races.paceDynamic: Cartwheel and Star Start are the only genuine front-runners in this 22-runner field, setting up a likely contested early lead that could create an honest gallop. The large field with numerous hold-up horses (King Of York, Rising Force, King Of Speed, Luminous Warrior) means pace pressure will build through the race, favoring those who can settle and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Cartwheel and Star Start engage in a speed duel from the start
scenarios.body: The two leaders burn each other out in the first half-mile, creating a strong gallop that sets up the race for the closers. King Of York and Rising Force benefit most from the honest pace, with prominent runners like Dapper Gee Gee and Ey Up Its Jazz struggling to bridge the gap.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If one front-runner gets an uncontested lead while the other settles
scenarios.body: Star Start or Cartwheel steals a march with softer fractions, making it difficult for the large pack of hold-up horses to close the gap in time. The prominent runners Asian Journey and Tees George find themselves in the perfect stalking position to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate with both leaders compromising
scenarios.body: A bunched field turns into a cavalry charge in the final two furlongs as 15+ horses remain in contention. The prominent racers who avoided traffic troubles and those hold-up horses with clear runs benefit from the scramble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closer's Paradise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely with neither leader committing
scenarios.body: An extremely slow early pace leaves too much to do for the front-runners, creating a true test of finishing speed. The best of the hold-up merchants with proven turn of foot get their ideal scenario in the final three furlongs.

watchPoints.text: Cartwheel and Star Start's early battle will determine whether closers or speed horses dominate the finish
Traffic problems are inevitable with 22 runners, particularly affecting Asian Journey and Port Louis who need smooth passages
Ey Up Its Jazz's soft ground superiority could be decisive if the race becomes a sprint finish
King Of York's draw and early position will indicate whether he can secure the ideal stalking spot
Rising Force needs to be handy enough early to avoid being trapped behind the large field of runners

races.paceDynamic: It'sneverjustone will likely lead with Jimmy Speaking and Tactical Plan tracking prominently, creating a moderate but sustainable gallop early. The large field of predominantly hold-up horses means the pace could become pedestrian through the middle sections, setting up a cavalry charge finish where positioning and draw will be crucial.

scenarios.trigger: If It'sneverjustone, Jimmy Speaking and Tactical Plan all go forward aggressively
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes genuinely strong as the prominent runners engage, stretching the field and creating gaps. Late closers with stamina like Quest For Fun and An Outlaw's Grace can pick off tired leaders.

scenarios.trigger: If It'sneverjustone gets an easy lead with no pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl until the final 2f, creating a bunched field and sprint finish. Horses with turn of foot like Grabajabba and Jimmy Speaking thrive in the resulting melee.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Draw Bias Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the soft going creates a significant rail bias or wide track advantage
scenarios.body: Track position becomes decisive regardless of pace dynamics, favoring horses drawn to exploit the best ground. The tactical shape matters less than being in the right part of the course.

With most of the field preferring to come from behind (Too Soon, Harvey, Have Secret, Knights Gold, Spoken Truth, Say What You See all hold-up types), the pace-setters will have company early before the race develops into a stamina test over the final 3f on testing ground.

scenarios.body: Castle Stuart, Ashnak or Spioradalta track the leaders without over-racing and time their move perfectly. They get first run on the weakening pace-setters and hold off the deep closers.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate early
scenarios.body: The leaders don't go fast enough early allowing hold-up horses to get into contention sooner. Say What You See or Harvey produce devastating late kicks to overhaul the entire field.

races.paceDynamic: My Mate Kev stands as the sole confirmed front runner in this 18-runner field, meaning he can dictate the pace without early pressure from fellow leaders. With prominent runners like Fuji Mountain, Thunder Star, Our Absent Friends, Yes I'm Mali, Emperor Caradoc, Ay Gee Ell, I Need Your Love, Thornaby Pearl, The Fixer, Vince L'Amour, and J Street likely to settle just behind, the pace should be honest but not frantic early. This sets up perfectly for the large contingent of hold-up horses including Charlie Mason, Spoof, Juan Les Pins, Glory Hyde, Harry's Halo, and Impressor to get their preferred strong finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If My Mate Kev gets soft fractions with the prominent pack not pressuring early.
scenarios.body: The leader builds a useful advantage before the cavalry charge begins, giving him enough cushion to resist the closers. The hold-up horses come too late despite the strong pace suiting their style.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners bunch up behind My Mate Kev and create a strong gallop throughout.
scenarios.body: The sustained pace sets up perfectly for the hold-up merchants who get the strong end-to-end gallop they need. Juan Les Pins and Spoof benefit most from their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners like Fuji Mountain or Vince L'Amour injects pace from the 3f pole.
scenarios.body: The move catches My Mate Kev and puts enough pressure on to soften up the early leaders while not allowing the hold-up horses time to organize. The mid-move horse gets first run on the field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Dash Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses with My Mate Kev going too slow and the prominent pack being too patient.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the best turn of foot wins rather than stamina and positioning. Harry's Halo and Glory Hyde can unleash their finishing kicks from ideal positions.
